phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.notes: Checked GitHub Desktop, Git worktree, Tauri dialog, Linear project docs, and issue/discussion signals.

phases.label: Source review and slice planning
phases.notes: Reviewed ProjectManagementPanel, collector, snapshot type, MonitorShell routing, tests, CSS, and source maps.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.notes: Created request summary, requirements, spec, plan, tasks, validation, traceability, mode, large-scope, and coding research records.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.notes: Extended snapshot model and collector, split project UI into subcomponents, added detail/action/report UI, and wired project action routing.

phases.label: Verification
phases.notes: Ran collector, check, tests, build, platform test/check, docs audit, diff check, and Browser desktop/mobile smoke.

phases.label: Evaluation and close-out
phases.notes: Completed omission/resource/evaluation records, customer renderer build verification, and final git preparation.

bottleneck_analysis.bottleneck_notes: The main cost was keeping snapshot data, UI split, route behavior, tests, source maps, and generated snapshot output aligned.
improvement_candidates: Split the large snapshot type and collector into feature modules so future model changes do not touch oversized files.
Create a reusable readiness source aggregation helper for feature-split components.
Promote Browser smoke checks for project sections into a deterministic Playwright script.
